$OGN Q3 2026: revenue $1.6B, -2% Y/Y, driven by its women's health and biosimilars portfolio. Operating margin reached 16.2% as operating expenses remained flat. #earnings #pharma
$NVT Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +44% Y/Y, driven by broad-based double-digit sales growth across all verticals. Operating margin 18.6%. #earnings #industrials
$WELPP Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +14% Y/Y, driven by strong electric and natural gas distribution demand in Wisconsin. Operating margin 29.1%; operating cash flow $546M. #earnings #utilities
$CBOE Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +19% Y/Y, driven by options growth as the segment rose 19% and made up 54% of revenue. Operating margin reached 39.3%; operating cash flow $817M. #earnings #finance
$EMN Q3 2026: revenue $2.4B, +8% Y/Y, driven by higher selling prices and sales volume mix, alongside improved asset utilization. Operating margin 10.4%. #earnings #materials
BREAKING: $URI disclosed a material agreement in an 8-K (Item 1.01) alongside Q3 revenue of $4.9B (+16% Y/Y). How do you read it — 1) growth 2) diversification 3) wait? #8K #deal

$AMP Q3 2026: revenue $5.2B, +6% Y/Y, driven by higher assets under management and advisement as equity markets appreciated. Operating margin 28.9%; net earnings $1.1B. #earnings #finance
$CLR Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, -33% Y/Y, as negative derivative adjustments offset higher commodity sales. Operating margin 9.0%. #earnings #oil
